name: Data Storytelling
description: Turn a dataset into a defensible narrative with reproducible analysis, honest graphics, uncertainty, and source traceability.

tasks.name: Define the editorial question
tasks.objective: Specify audience, decision or insight sought, unit of analysis, relevant populations, comparison groups, time windows, and claims the data can and cannot support.

tasks.name: Audit the data
tasks.objective: Inspect provenance, collection method, schema, missingness, duplicates, outliers, weighting, joins, denominator changes, measurement drift, revisions, and known biases.

tasks.name: Run reproducible analysis
tasks.objective: Compute the required summaries, comparisons, trends, uncertainty, sensitivity checks, and alternative specifications with traceable transformations.

tasks.name: Design truthful visualizations
tasks.objective: Choose encodings suited to the question, label units and denominators, show uncertainty where material, avoid distorted axes or decorative clutter, and include accessible text alternatives.

tasks.name: Build the narrative
tasks.objective: Sequence context, finding, evidence, caveats, counter-patterns, and implications without promoting correlation to causation or burying inconvenient results.

tasks.name: Package reproducible story
tasks.objective: Deliver charts, narrative, data/source notes, methodology, transformation log, caveats, accessibility descriptions, and update instructions.
